items.label: Enable Autotracking
items.desc: Read your items, keys, dungeon progress and checked locations from the running game through SNI or QUsb2snes, so you don't have to track by hand.

items.label: Assume old man access on item collect
items.desc: When the old man item has been collected, assume logical access to Old Man S&Q spot without placing Old Man rescue caves

items.label: Always Count Dungeon Items
items.desc: Include dungeon items (maps, compasses, small keys, big keys and prizes) in dungeon chest counters even when they stay in their own dungeon. When off, counters only count the checks that hold items shuffled outside of the dungeon.

breaks.label: Dark Room Navigation
breaks.desc: Navigate dark rooms without a light source (lamp/firerod)

breaks.label: Ice Breaker
breaks.desc: Use somaria to clip through the wall in IP Big Key Chest Room

breaks.label: Bomb Jumps
breaks.desc: Use bomb recoil to cross gaps

breaks.label: Hover
breaks.desc: Use boots + Pegasus to hover across gaps

breaks.label: Mirror Super Bunny
breaks.desc: Enter caves/dungeons as superbunny by mirror-canceling on the frame of entry. Sequence break in No Glitches; in logic for glitched modes.

breaks.label: Superbunny Cave Drop
breaks.desc: Get the Superbunny Cave chests without the Moon Pearl by dropping down its hole as a bunny. Sequence break in No Glitches; automatically in logic for glitched modes.
